question: True or false: in Germany, consumer contracts signed since 2022 cannot roll over automatically for another full year?
answer: True. Under the Fair Consumer Contracts Act, contracts made from March 2022 may still bind for up to two years at first, but afterwards they can renew only open-ended, cancellable at a month's notice. Since July 2022, contracts sold online must also carry a cancellation button. A forgotten gym contract now costs one month, not twelve.
move: When a cost comes from forgetting, the default decides who pays.
trap: Assuming yearly rollovers are standard everywhere, as in many other countries.
